description: Frontend self-reporting: (1) fix the providers store `load()` so an IPC throw is no longer silently swallowed (the clean-empty cause A) - track a load state + last error the UI can read; (2) surface a prominent, copyable state line in the chat model-selector area; and (3) add an always-reachable Settings 'Diagnostics' section that renders the per-provider readout from the new `provider_diagnostics` command with a Run diagnostics / Refresh button. Depends on FEAT-001 (the provider_diagnostics command + Rust boundary shape). This is the PRIMARY deliverable: the user's built app must self-report what actually happened so the next report is a precise readout instead of 'nothing'.
steps: FIX crates/../frontend/src/state/providers.ts load() throw-swallowing (clean-empty cause A). Extend ProvidersState with a load-status the UI can render: add fields `loadState: "idle" | "loading" | "loaded" | "failed"` and `lastError: string | null` (initialize idle/null). Rewrite load() to: set loadState "loading"; try { const result = await listAvailableModels(); set({ models: result.models ?? [], errors: result.errors ?? [], loadState: "loaded", lastError: null }); } catch (e) { set({ loadState: "failed", lastError: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }); } so a thrown/rejected IPC call is CAPTURED into lastError (display-safe - it is the CommandError message) instead of leaving models:[]/errors:[] with no signal. Do NOT clear models on failure beyond leaving them as-is. Keep applyCoreEvent unchanged.

ADD a prominent state line near the chat picker in frontend/src/features/model-selector/PerMessageOverrideControl.tsx. Read loadState, lastError, models, errors from the providers store. Render a small, token-styled, COPYABLE status line (data-testid="model-load-status") that reads e.g. "loading…" when loadState===loading; "loaded N models from M providers" when loaded (N = models.length, M = distinct providerId count among models); and "failed: <lastError>" when loadState===failed. Place it above the existing <ProviderEnumerationErrors errors={errors} />. Keep the existing Refresh button (it already calls load()). Ensure the component tolerates undefined/empty arrays defensively (mirror the Array.isArray guard used in ProviderEnumerationErrors).

ADD frontend/src/types/index.ts TS types mirroring the FEAT-001 Rust serde shapes exactly (camelCase): `export interface ProviderDiagnostic { id: string; kind: ProviderKind; baseUrl: string | null; instanceBuilt: boolean; modelCount: number; error: string | null; }` and `export interface ProviderDiagnosticsReport { configuredCount: number; totalModelCount: number; providerCountWithModels: number; providers: ProviderDiagnostic[]; }`. Match the Rust field names/optionality precisely (Option<String> -> string | null). Add a doc comment in the file's existing hand-mirrored style noting it mirrors commands::ProviderDiagnostic(sReport) and is DISPLAY-SAFE.

ADD the IPC wrapper in frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts: `export function providerDiagnostics(): Promise<ProviderDiagnosticsReport> { return invoke<ProviderDiagnosticsReport>("provider_diagnostics"); }` with a doc comment mirroring listAvailableModels' style (Backed by `provider_diagnostics`; DISPLAY-SAFE). Add ProviderDiagnosticsReport to the type import list at the top of the file.

CREATE frontend/src/features/settings/DiagnosticsSection.tsx: a self-contained section that on mount calls providerDiagnostics() and renders a plain-text, copyable readout. Follow the mount-load pattern used by LocalRuntimesSection / ProviderKeysSection (useEffect on mount, local useState for the report + loading/error). Render: a role="region" aria-label="Diagnostics" wrapper; a prominent summary line (data-testid="diagnostics-summary") "loading… / loaded: N models from M of K configured providers / failed: <error>" including if the provider_diagnostics IPC call itself threw (catch it - do NOT let it leave a blank panel); a table/list (data-testid="diagnostics-providers") with one row PER configured provider showing id, kind, baseUrl (display-safe, shown as the literal string or 'default' when null - NEVER a key), instanceBuilt (yes/no), modelCount, and error (when present); and a 'Run diagnostics' / 'Refresh' button (data-testid="diagnostics-refresh") that re-invokes providerDiagnostics() and updates the panel. Keep all text plain and copyable. Add the component to frontend/src/features/settings/index.ts if that barrel re-exports sections (check the file first).

WIRE the Diagnostics section into frontend/src/features/settings/Settings.tsx: add `{ id: "diagnostics", label: "Diagnostics" }` to the SECTIONS array (place it last, after 'about', or right after 'localRuntimes' - choose a sensible position and keep the SettingsSection union type in sync) and render `{section === "diagnostics" && <DiagnosticsSection />}` in the switch. Import DiagnosticsSection.

UPDATE frontend TESTS - this is the failure class that cost prior CI cycles, trace EVERY affected test: (a) frontend/src/app.test.tsx routeInvoke() switch MUST gain a `case "provider_diagnostics": return { configuredCount: 0, totalModelCount: 0, providerCountWithModels: 0, providers: [] };` so any surface that calls it never resolves undefined (App does not mount Settings by default, but add the case defensively AND because switching to Settings in existing tests must not break). (b) frontend/src/features/settings/settings.test.tsx: the default `invoke.mockResolvedValue([])` returns [] for every command; if DiagnosticsSection mounts a load, add a mockImplementation branch (or extend existing ones) returning a well-formed ProviderDiagnosticsReport object for "provider_diagnostics" in the tests that navigate to or render the Diagnostics section, and add at least one test that clicks the 'Diagnostics' settings button and asserts the region + summary render. Ensure the existing 'renders the sub-navigation and each section' test still passes (it clicks through sections; if it now must reach Diagnostics, give it a provider_diagnostics mock). (c) providers store test frontend/src/state/providers.test.ts: add a test that when listAvailableModels() REJECTS, load() sets loadState 'failed' and lastError to the error message and does NOT throw (the clean-empty cause A regression); keep existing tests green (they now also implicitly exercise loadState 'loaded'). (d) model-selector.test.tsx: if the new model-load-status line changes the DOM the refresh/empty tests assert on, update them; add an assertion that the status line reads the loaded/failed text. (e) commands.test.ts: add a unit test for providerDiagnostics() asserting it invokes "provider_diagnostics" and returns the mocked report shape (mirror the listAvailableModels test).

SELF-AUDIT the frontend changes for the four failure classes: tsc strict (no reads of possibly-undefined report fields - guard with the report state; ProviderKind union is imported where used), eslint no-unused-vars (remove any unused imports; if you import ProviderDiagnosticsReport only as a type, it is fine as a type import), prettier formatting (run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from frontend/ IF the prettier binary is available offline - if not, format by hand to match .prettierrc.json: 2-space indent, double quotes, trailing commas, 100 col), and vitest mock completeness (grep every *.test.tsx that mounts <App/>, <Settings/>, or model-selector surfaces and confirm each has a provider_diagnostics-safe mock and a list_available_models {models,errors} mock so no new call resolves undefined). Record in findings exactly which test files' mocks were updated and which checks were offline-verified vs. CI-deferred.
acceptance_criteria: providers store load() no longer swallows IPC rejections: on a rejected listAvailableModels() it sets loadState 'failed' and lastError to the error message (proven by a new providers.test.ts test) and never leaves the clean models:[]/errors:[] state with no signal.
The chat model-selector area renders a copyable status line (data-testid="model-load-status") reading loading… / loaded N models from M providers / failed: <error>.

A new Settings 'Diagnostics' section is always reachable and renders, per configured provider, id + kind + display-safe baseUrl + instanceBuilt + modelCount + error, plus a summary line and a working Run diagnostics / Refresh button that re-invokes provider_diagnostics.
The Diagnostics section catches an IPC throw from provider_diagnostics and shows 'failed: <error>' rather than a blank panel.
New TS types ProviderDiagnostic / ProviderDiagnosticsReport mirror the Rust serde shape (camelCase, Option -> null) and a providerDiagnostics() IPC wrapper calls the "provider_diagnostics" command.

All frontend tests pass in CI: app.test.tsx routeInvoke handles provider_diagnostics; settings.test.tsx exercises the Diagnostics section with a well-formed mock; providers.test.ts covers the throw path; commands.test.ts covers providerDiagnostics(); no test's new IPC call resolves undefined.
No secret/key material or resolved SecretRef appears anywhere in the diagnostics UI or types (baseUrl only; hasApiKey-style booleans are acceptable but keys are never shown).
verification: Offline: from frontend/, `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` reports no diff IF the prettier binary is present; otherwise confirm formatting by review against .prettierrc.json. Code review confirms every <App/>/<Settings/>/model-selector test has provider_diagnostics + list_available_models mocks.

CI (deferred, orchestrator drives): from frontend/, `npm run test` (vitest), `npm run lint` (eslint), and tsc via the build all pass with the new Diagnostics section, IPC wrapper, types, and store changes.
findings:
Implemented the frontend self-report for the clean-empty model-picker bug, consuming FEAT-001's provider_diagnostics command. Files touched (source): - frontend/src/state/providers.ts: added `ProvidersLoadState` type + `loadState`/`lastError` fields (init idle/null). Rewrote load() to set loadState 'loading', then try { listAvailableModels() -> set models/errors/'loaded'/lastError null } catch { set 'failed' + lastError (Error.message or String(e)) }. A rejected IPC call is now CAPTURED (no longer swallowed by app.tsx's void load()); models are left as-is on failure (not blanked). applyCoreEvent unchanged. - frontend/src/types/index.ts: added `ProviderDiagnostic` { id, kind: ProviderKind, baseUrl: string|null, instanceBuilt, modelCount, error: string|null } and `ProviderDiagnosticsReport` { configuredCount, totalModelCount, providerCountWithModels, providers: ProviderDiagnostic[] } after AvailableModelsResult, in the file's hand-mirrored camelCase style with DISPLAY-SAFE doc comments. Verified field names/optionality against crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs lines 579-614 (Option -> string|null, usize -> number). - frontend/src/ipc/commands.ts: added ProviderDiagnosticsReport to the type import list and `providerDiagnostics(): Promise` invoking 'provider_diagnostics', with a DISPLAY-SAFE doc comment mirroring listAvailableModels. - frontend/src/features/model-selector/PerMessageOverrideControl.tsx: reads loadState/lastError; renders a copyable

above reading 'loading…' / 'failed: ' / 'loaded N models from M providers' (N=models.length, M=distinct providerId count via a Set). Array.isArray guard mirrors ProviderEnumerationErrors. Refresh button unchanged. - frontend/src/features/settings/DiagnosticsSection.tsx (NEW): role="region" aria-label="Diagnostics"; on-mount useEffect calls providerDiagnostics() with local report/loading/error state (mount-load pattern from LocalRuntimesSection/ProviderKeysSection). Summary line (data-testid="diagnostics-summary") = 'loading…' / 'failed: ' (catches the IPC throw so never a blank panel) / 'loaded: N models from M of K configured providers'. Per-provider list (data-testid="diagnostics-providers") shows id, kind, baseUrl (or 'default' when null), instance built yes/no, modelCount, and error when present. 'Run diagnostics' button (data-testid="diagnostics-refresh") re-invokes. All report reads guarded behind non-null state (tsc strict). No barrel file exists at frontend/src/features/settings/ (confirmed) so no barrel export was added; wired directly. - frontend/src/features/settings/Settings.tsx: added 'diagnostics' to the SettingsSection union (reformatted to multiline union) and { id: 'diagnostics', label: 'Diagnostics' } to SECTIONS (before 'about'); imported DiagnosticsSection and rendered {section === 'diagnostics' && }. Test files whose mocks/assertions were updated (the CI failure class): - frontend/src/app.test.tsx: routeInvoke() switch gained `case "provider_diagnostics": return { configuredCount:0, totalModelCount:0, providerCountWithModels:0, providers:[] };` (defensive; App does not mount Settings by default). - frontend/src/features/settings/settings.test.tsx: the 'renders the sub-navigation and each section' test now sets a mockImplementation returning a well-formed ProviderDiagnosticsReport for 'provider_diagnostics' (else []), and clicks the new Diagnostics button asserting the region renders. Added two tests: (1) navigates to Diagnostics with a 2-provider report and asserts the summary text 'loaded: 3 models from 1 of 2 configured providers', the per-provider list content (ollama-local, 'default', the transport error, the openai baseUrl), and that diagnostics-refresh re-invokes provider_diagnostics; (2) asserts a rejected provider_diagnostics yields 'failed: ' in the summary (never a blank panel). - frontend/src/state/providers.test.ts: beforeEach reset now includes loadState 'idle'/lastError null. Added a 'loaded' success-state assertion test and a rejection test proving load() resolves (does not throw) and sets loadState 'failed' + lastError to the error message. Existing tests kept green. - frontend/src/ipc/commands.test.ts: imported providerDiagnostics and added a unit test asserting invoke('provider_diagnostics') and the returned report shape (mirrors the listAvailableModels test). - frontend/src/features/model-selector/model-selector.test.tsx: resetStores() now resets loadState/lastError too. Added a status-line assertion ('loaded 1 models from 1 providers') to the errors-alongside-models test and a new test asserting the status line reads 'failed: provider registry build failed' after a rejected load. DISPLAY-SAFE audit: the diagnostics UI and the new TS types expose only id/kind/baseUrl/instanceBuilt/modelCount/error and counts; no key material, no resolved SecretRef. baseUrl is shown literally or as 'default' when null. Verified OFFLINE: `NODE_OPTIONS= npx --no-install prettier --check` (prettier 3.9.6 present via npx cache; node_modules is NOT installed) reports 'All matched files use Prettier code style!' for all touched .ts/.tsx files (one file, DiagnosticsSection.tsx, was auto-formatted with --write then re-checked clean). No dependencies added; package-lock.json unchanged. Self-audited: no unused imports (ProviderKind used in types; ProviderDiagnosticsReport is a type-only import in commands.ts and DiagnosticsSection.tsx); tsc-strict null guards on the report; no new IPC call resolves undefined in any App/Settings/model-selector test. Removed an em dash from DiagnosticsSection JSX per the no-em-dash rule. DEFERRED to CI (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox; npm 403, node_modules not installable): vitest (npm run test), eslint (npm run lint), and tsc via the Vite build. The orchestrator drives these after push.
